name: Usage meter reset
description: A white app card drops into the top band over the speaker: an orange sparkle icon, a title like 'Plan usage' and a day chip, a mono label ('WEEKLY LIMIT') with a big percentage, and a thick bar that sits full and pulsing; at the reset moment the bar drains to empty with a shine and turns green, the number counts down to 0%, the status line flips from a clock line to a green check line, and an orange tilted badge ('LOTS OF TOKENS') stamps in under the card.
use_when: Lines about limits, quotas, credits or tokens running out or resetting (AI plan limits, a free tier, data caps), or a fresh start with a full tank.

chip.help: small chip on the right, e.g. 'SUN'

reset_at.help: seconds from the scene start when the bar drains (the word 'reset')

badge.help: optional tilted badge under the card, e.g. 'Lots of tokens'

badge_at.help: seconds from the scene start when the badge stamps in
